unsupported.en: Scope or evidence incomplete; no permission.
unsupported.zh-CN: 范围或证据不全，不表示允许。

conditional.en: Reviewed rule eligibility with unresolved operations; not a confirmed route.
conditional.zh-CN: 已复核规则满足但操作条件待确认，非确认路线。

ineligible.en: Explicit operational contradiction excludes every candidate; draft legal failures alone do not reject.
ineligible.zh-CN: 明确操作冲突排除全部候选；草稿法律诊断失败本身不裁定拒绝。

verified_supported.en: Reviewed current rules and evidenced dated whole-route capacity/custody. None exists.
verified_supported.zh-CN: 现行规则已复核且全程日期限定运力与责任有证据；当前无此路线。

summary.en: Portal entry only; local instructions and cargo scope unverified.
summary.zh-CN: 仅确认携带出境宠物检疫入口；属地流程及独立货运范围待核。

summary.en: Carried export application and documents; current amendments and cargo process pending.
summary.zh-CN: 携带出境按输入地要求申请检疫及单证；现行修订和独立货运流程待核。

summary.en: Luohu only: 3–10 working-day application, agreed inspection, vaccination/chip/lab documents and delegation. No national service-time guarantee.
summary.zh-CN: 仅罗湖：提前3–10工作日申请、约定查验、芯片免疫检测材料和委托证明；非全国时限保证。

summary.en: Foreign-vaccinated high-risk dogs: form signed within 30 days, government endorsement, sample waits and ACF reservation; no titer requires quarantine branch.
summary.zh-CN: 境外接种高风险犬：30日内兽医签署、政府背书、采血等待及设施预约；无有效抗体报告须走隔离分支。

summary.en: Mainland China is listed; six-month history and vaccination origin require separate classification.
summary.zh-CN: 中国大陆列入名单；六个月旅行史与疫苗签发来源须分别分类。

summary.en: Carried dogs/cats only, one per person, official export and rabies documents, chip, arrival inspection; 30-day quarantine branch needs facilities. Current annex lists unverified.
summary.zh-CN: 仅携带犬猫，每人一只，官方出口检疫和免疫证、芯片、现场检疫；30日隔离分支需设施。现行附件名单未核。

summary.en: Dogs/cats export: issue within 14 days of arrival, VEHCS endorsement and printed copy. Titer boundary differs from dog PDF.
summary.zh-CN: 犬猫出口：到达前14日内签发、VEHCS背书及打印件；抗体边界与犬PDF不同。

summary.en: Four-page dog model: two vaccinations, sample on/after second vaccine, one-year sample validity, greater than 0.5. No cat model inference.
summary.zh-CN: 四页犬范本：两次免疫、第二次后或当日采血、采血一年有效、大于0.5；不推定猫范本。

summary.en: Cat PDF returned 503; webpage read does not establish full cat model content.
summary.zh-CN: 猫PDF返回503；网页查阅不证明猫范本已完整核实。

summary.en: Check binding destination certificate first; otherwise confirm legalisation. Vet completes certificate before legalisation; advance appointment uses working days, no computed guarantee.
summary.zh-CN: 先查目的地绑定证书，否则确认认证；兽医填签后认证。预约按工作日提前申请，不计算保证时限。

summary.en: District guidance: destination rules apply, official certificate application with supporting documents. Not national China export certification.
summary.zh-CN: 区级指引：遵守目的地规则，提交官方证书申请及材料；非全国赴中国出口证流程。

summary.en: Other-country section: passport and health preparation plus destination/transit and DDPP confirmation. Passport alone does not meet CN official export certificate.
summary.zh-CN: 其他国家段：护照、健康准备及目的地／过境与DDPP确认；护照不替代中国要求的官方出口检疫证。

summary.en: Public dog/cat hold policy; flight availability and conditions can cause refusal. No China flight, capacity or price verified.
summary.zh-CN: 公开犬猫行李舱政策；航班可用性及条件可能导致拒收；未核中国航段、运力或价格。

summary.en: New non-commercial model from October 1; issue and endorsement differ; manufacturer immunity may exceed 21 days.
summary.zh-CN: 10月1日起新非商业范本；签发与背书分开；厂商免疫等待可能超过21日。

summary.en: Readable 2026 model; endorsement to entry check 10 days, later intra-EU use limited by vaccine expiry; titre exceptions need current lists.
summary.zh-CN: 可读2026范本；背书至入境检查10日，后续欧盟内使用受免疫到期限制；抗体例外待核现行名单。

evidence.locator: Who can enter information; return documents

summary.en: Return passport depends on valid EU-vet rabies record. US revaccination requires a health certificate; US vets cannot fill EU-authorized sections.
summary.zh-CN: 返程护照依赖欧盟兽医有效免疫记录；美国再接种需卫生证，美国兽医不得填写欧盟授权栏。

summary.en: Specific US rabies form must be endorsed before leaving US. Export certificates after July 31 2025 cannot replace it.
summary.zh-CN: 美国专用免疫表须离美前背书；2025年7月31日后出口证不能替代。

summary.en: Six-month history matters; mainland China, Ceuta and Melilla are listed. No blanket EU geography exemption is inferred.
summary.zh-CN: 六个月历史影响分类；中国大陆、休达、梅利利亚列名，不按欧盟地理名称整体豁免。

summary.en: Low-risk receipt country must match departure; receipt expiry/history change require reassessment.
summary.zh-CN: 低风险回执国家须与起运地一致；到期及历史改变需重评。

summary.en: Foreign-vaccinated high-risk dogs need an ACF reservation and separate document chain.
summary.zh-CN: 境外免疫高风险犬需设施预约及独立文件链。

summary.en: Cats require healthy arrival and inspection; no CDC dog form, age or chip rule applied. States/carriers remain separate.
summary.zh-CN: 猫需健康抵达及检查；不套犬CDC表、年龄、芯片要求；州与承运方条件独立。

evidence.locator: Articles 3, 6; Annex III / V: model correspondence pending
